dict.string: NeuralCompose connects to your Muse headband over Bluetooth to read EEG locally. EEG data never leaves your machine.

NeuralCompose captures microphone audio only while you press and hold the dictation button, and processes it entirely on-device via Apple's Speech framework. Audio never leaves your machine and is never captured continuously.
NeuralCompose uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe dictated text into your composed sentence, only while you press and hold the dictation button.
